_doc: The `claude` and `claude-supervisor` entries belong under .agents.providers in ~/.paseo/config.json; merge them in once per machine.
The `claude-lead-SLUG` and `pi-peer-SLUG` entries are templates: setup/add-project.fish copies them for each project, replacing SLUG and adding env.SEATWORKS_REPO.
Merge into the existing file; don't replace it, because it also holds workspaces and the agent ledger.
Also make sure .daemon.mcp has "enabled": true and "injectIntoAgents": true, or the Lead and Supervisor get no Paseo tools.
Replace HOME_DIR with the real home directory and OAUTH_TOKEN with your CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Seats inherit the token from `claude` through `extends`.
Delete the _doc key before writing: Paseo's schema rejects unknown keys.

claude-supervisor.label: Claude Supervisor Seat
claude-supervisor.description: Supervisor seat for every project: meets the Human, relays decisions, observes, keeps the notebook

claude-lead-SLUG.description: Lead seat for SLUG: framing, delegation, review, acceptance

pi-peer-SLUG.description: Peer seat for SLUG: implementation, evidence, handoff
